scope: future-only games locked under snapshots/<game_id>/<locked_utc>/ before kickoff
historical_note: No 2025/2026 game already played when this protocol was written counts as pristine holdout evidence; weeks 1-9 of 2026 were seen during development.

eligible_snapshot.covered_by_freeze: lock hash listed in PROTOCOL_FREEZE.json, or locked after the freeze

comparison: model vs each book's own no-vig probability at the frozen quote (raw model only; no market anchoring)
one_lock_per_game: the latest eligible lock before kickoff is scored; earlier locks are recorded but not scored
